worked_example.dataset_boundary: Independent teaching example, not an observed patient case and not Alex. Alex’s 2.1 mg/L result, history and context remain unchanged.

labReference.meaning: Within this documented adult assay reference; laboratories may use different limits. This is not proof of optimal health.
labReference.location: Section 13, PDF page 18 (zero-based page 17), lines 643–645 in web extraction; clinical relevance section PDF page 3.

prevention.meaning: An ESC/EAS 2025 cardiovascular risk modifier considered with overall health history and risk factors, not a universal optimum, diagnosis or treatment target.
prevention.location: Box 1, risk modifiers beyond SCORE2/SCORE2-OP; in the co-published Atherosclerosis PDF this is PDF page 6. Official ESC slide set also reproduces the risk-modifier box.

prospectiveEvidence.study: Emerging Risk Factors Collaboration, Lancet 2010; 160,309 people without prior vascular disease in 54 prospective studies.
prospectiveEvidence.meaning: Association with later cardiovascular events; not an individual prediction or evidence that CRP itself is causal.

worked_example.context: Repeat when clinically stable; illness, infection, injury and other inflammatory causes can affect hs-CRP. Timing depends on clinical context; no universal interval or automatic treatment is specified.
worked_example.review: Clinical facts and copy are unchanged from67–68. Current69 renderer proportions and exact numeric geometry were independently verified; no new medical or human approval is claimed.

domain.meaning: One common 0–5 display domain matching the dashboard hs-CRP fixture/CapsuleRange; not EvidenceRange’s adaptive per-result domain.

representation.review: >2 if persistent is a separate named footer, never another favourable fill.
representation.cursor: Two aligned ring/core markers at 64%, matching the dashboard evidence instrument visual family. Bold 3.2/3,2 axis label identifies the shared sample.

dot_field.refinement: Slim dashboard-derived ribbons informed by inspected public SAVEE still references.

lowerRelativeRiskCategory.meaning: AHA lower relative cardiovascular-risk category based on hs-CRP; not overall risk or a universal optimal/treatment target.
lowerRelativeRiskCategory.location: PDF page2: hsCRP ranges, relative CVD risk categories. Lower <1, average 1–3, higher >3; distinct from overall PREVENT-ASCVD risk.

graphic_contrast.method: Core compositing of essential bright interval dots at measured native positions; dim outside dots provide context, not sole meaning.

limits: Agent image reading is not human usability research, clinician approval or actual owner acceptance.
The lower band represents one marker’s relative-risk category, not a universal optimal range or overall health.
Short phones scroll naturally; no clipping or font reduction forces the richer numeric comparison into one viewport.
Fine dotted comma can look period-like at 320; Spanish data, shared-axis label and accessible text are3,2.
No real health data, accounts, purchases, backend activation, DNS or evahealth.es cutover.
Review query is a label, not a version pin.

Dim outside-interval dots are subtle on320; the explicit labels, boundaries, aligned markers and direct conclusions retain the comparison. Viewport emulation cannot establish physical-screen visibility.
